```{r baw-original}
# ============================================
# AMERICAN BLACK-SCHOLES (Barone-Adesi & Whaley) - Original Implementation
# ============================================

# Critical price for American Call using Newton-Raphson
find_S_star_call <- function(K, r, sigma, T, q) {
  cat("DEBUG find_S_star_call: K =", K, "r =", r, "sigma =", sigma, "T =", T, "q =", q, "\n")
  
  if (q <= 0) {
    cat("DEBUG: q <= 0, returning Inf (no early exercise for non-dividend calls)\n")
    return(Inf)
  }
  
  N <- 2 * r / (sigma^2)
  M <- 2 * (r - q) / (sigma^2)
  q2_inf <- (-(N - 1) + sqrt((N - 1)^2 + 4 * M / K)) / 2
  
  cat("DEBUG: N =", N, "M =", M, "q2_inf =", q2_inf, "\n")
  
  if (q2_inf == 0) {
    cat("DEBUG ERROR: q2_inf is zero!\n")
    return(Inf)
  }
  
  S_star <- K
  cat("DEBUG: Initial S_star =", S_star, "\n")
  
  for (i in 1:100) {
    d1 <- (log(S_star / K) + (r - q + sigma^2 / 2) * T) / (sigma * sqrt(T))
    lhs <- S_star - K
    rhs <- bs_european_call(S_star, K, r, sigma, T, q) + 
           (1 - exp(-q * T) * pnorm(d1)) * S_star / q2_inf
    
    cat("DEBUG: Iter", i, "S_star =", S_star, "d1 =", d1, "\n")
    cat("DEBUG:   lhs =", lhs, "rhs =", rhs, "diff =", abs(lhs - rhs), "\n")
    
    if (abs(lhs - rhs) < 1e-6) {
      cat("DEBUG: Converged at iteration", i, "\n")
      break
    }
    
    denom <- (1 - exp(-q * T) * pnorm(d1))
    cat("DEBUG:   denom =", denom, "\n")
    
    if (abs(denom) < 1e-10) {
      cat("DEBUG ERROR: Denominator too small (", denom, ") at iteration", i, "\n")
      break
    }
    
    S_star_new <- K + rhs - bs_european_call(S_star, K, r, sigma, T, q) * q2_inf / denom
    cat("DEBUG:   S_star_new =", S_star_new, "\n")
    
    if (S_star_new <= 0 || is.infinite(S_star_new) || is.nan(S_star_new)) {
      cat("DEBUG ERROR: S_star became", S_star_new, "at iteration", i, "\n")
      cat("DEBUG:   Components: K =", K, "rhs =", rhs, "q2_inf =", q2_inf, "denom =", denom, "\n")
      break
    }
    
    S_star <- S_star_new
  }
  
  cat("DEBUG: Final S_star =", S_star, "\n")
  return(S_star)
}

# Critical price for American Put using Newton-Raphson
find_S_star_put <- function(K, r, sigma, T, q) {
  cat("DEBUG find_S_star_put: K =", K, "r =", r, "sigma =", sigma, "T =", T, "q =", q, "\n")
  
  N <- 2 * r / (sigma^2)
  M <- 2 * (r - q) / (sigma^2)
  q1_inf <- (-(N - 1) + sqrt((N - 1)^2 + 4 * M)) / 2
  
  cat("DEBUG PUT S*: N =", N, "M =", M, "q1_inf =", q1_inf, "\n")
  
  if (q1_inf == 0) {
    cat("DEBUG PUT S*: ERROR - q1_inf is zero!\n")
    return(NaN)
  }
  
  S_star <- K
  cat("DEBUG PUT S*: Initial S_star =", S_star, "\n")
  
  for (i in 1:100) {
    d1 <- (log(S_star / K) + (r - q + sigma^2 / 2) * T) / (sigma * sqrt(T))
    lhs <- K - S_star
    rhs <- bs_european_put(S_star, K, r, sigma, T, q) - 
           (1 - exp(-q * T) * pnorm(-d1)) * S_star / q1_inf
    
    cat("DEBUG PUT S*: Iter", i, "S_star =", S_star, "d1 =", d1, "\n")
    cat("DEBUG PUT S*:   lhs =", lhs, "rhs =", rhs, "diff =", abs(lhs - rhs), "\n")
    
    if (abs(lhs - rhs) < 1e-6) {
      cat("DEBUG PUT S*: Converged at iteration", i, "\n")
      break
    }
    
    denom <- (1 - exp(-q * T) * pnorm(-d1))
    cat("DEBUG PUT S*:   denom =", denom, "\n")
    
    if (abs(denom) < 1e-10) {
      cat("DEBUG PUT S*: ERROR - Denominator too small (", denom, ") at iteration", i, "\n")
      break
    }
    
    S_star_new <- K - rhs + bs_european_put(S_star, K, r, sigma, T, q) * q1_inf / denom
    cat("DEBUG PUT S*:   S_star_new =", S_star_new, "\n")
    
    if (S_star_new <= 0 || is.infinite(S_star_new) || is.nan(S_star_new)) {
      cat("DEBUG PUT S*: ERROR - S_star became", S_star_new, "at iteration", i, "\n")
      cat("DEBUG PUT S*:   Components: K =", K, "rhs =", rhs, "q1_inf =", q1_inf, "denom =", denom, "\n")
      break
    }
    
    S_star <- S_star_new
  }
  
  cat("DEBUG PUT S*: Final S_star =", S_star, "\n")
  return(S_star)
}

# American Call Option (Barone-Adesi & Whaley)
bs_american_call <- function(S, K, r, sigma, T, q = 0) {
  if (q <= 0) {
    # No early exercise premium for non-dividend calls
    return(bs_european_call(S, K, r, sigma, T, q))
  }
  
  european_price <- bs_european_call(S, K, r, sigma, T, q)
  
  N <- 2 * r / (sigma^2)
  M <- 2 * (r - q) / (sigma^2)
  q2 <- (-(N - 1) - sqrt((N - 1)^2 + 4 * M)) / 2
  
  S_star <- find_S_star_call(K, r, sigma, T, q)
  
  if (is.infinite(S_star) || S_star <= 0) {
    return(european_price)
  }
  
  d1 <- (log(S_star / K) + (r - q + sigma^2 / 2) * T) / (sigma * sqrt(T))
  A2 <- (1 - exp(-q * T) * pnorm(d1)) * S_star / q2
  
  if (S >= S_star) {
    return(S - K)
  } else {
    return(european_price + A2 * (S / S_star)^q2)
  }
}

# American Put Option (Barone-Adesi & Whaley)
bs_american_put <- function(S, K, r, sigma, T, q = 0) {
  european_price <- bs_european_put(S, K, r, sigma, T, q)
  
  N <- 2 * r / (sigma^2)
  M <- 2 * (r - q) / (sigma^2)
  discriminant <- (N - 1)^2 + 4 * M
  
  cat("DEBUG PUT: N =", N, "M =", M, "discriminant =", discriminant, "\n")
  
  if (discriminant < 0) {
    cat("DEBUG PUT: Negative discriminant, returning European price\n")
    return(european_price)
  }
  
  q1 <- (-(N - 1) + sqrt(discriminant)) / 2
  cat("DEBUG PUT: q1 =", q1, "\n")
  
  S_star <- find_S_star_put(K, r, sigma, T, q)
  cat("DEBUG PUT: S_star =", S_star, "\n")
  
  if (S_star <= 0 || is.nan(S_star) || is.infinite(S_star)) {
    cat("DEBUG PUT: Invalid S_star, returning European price\n")
    return(european_price)
  }
  
  d1 <- (log(S_star / K) + (r - q + sigma^2 / 2) * T) / (sigma * sqrt(T))
  cat("DEBUG PUT: d1 =", d1, "\n")
  
  A1 <- -(1 - exp(-q * T) * pnorm(-d1)) * S_star / q1
  cat("DEBUG PUT: A1 =", A1, "\n")
  
  cat("DEBUG PUT: S =", S, "S_star =", S_star, "S <= S_star:", S <= S_star, "\n")
  
  if (S <= S_star) {
    result <- K - S
    cat("DEBUG PUT: Early exercise, returning:", result, "\n")
    return(result)
  } else {
    S_ratio <- S / S_star
    cat("DEBUG PUT: S_ratio =", S_ratio, "S_ratio^q1 =", S_ratio^q1, "\n")
    result <- european_price + A1 * S_ratio^q1
    cat("DEBUG PUT: Final result:", result, "\n")
    return(result)
  }
}
```

```{r baw-user}
# ============================================
# USER'S BAW IMPLEMENTATION
# ============================================

# Critical price for American Call using Newton-Raphson
find_S_star_call_user <- function(S, X, r, sigma, T, q) {
  b <- r - q
  
  d1 <- function(S_in) {
    return((log(S_in/X) + (b + sigma^2 / 2) * T) / (sigma * sqrt(T)))
  }
  
  # Calculate q_2 (quadratic root)
  M <- (2*r)/sigma^2
  N_param <- (2*b)/sigma^2
  q_2 <- (-(N_param - 1) - sqrt((N_param - 1)^2 + 4 * M)) / 2
  
  LHS <- function(Si) {
    return(Si - X)
  }
  
  RHS <- function(Si) {
    return(bs_european_call(Si, X, r, sigma, T, q) + (1 - exp(-q * T) * pnorm(d1(Si))) * Si / q_2)
  }
  
  # Initial guess using approximation
  # S_inf is the critical price for perpetual option
  S_inf <- X / (1 - 2 / (-(N_param - 1) + sqrt((N_param - 1)^2 + 4 * M)))
  h2 <- -(b * T + 2 * sigma * sqrt(T)) * (X / (S_inf - X))
  Si <- X + (S_inf - X) * (1 - exp(h2))
  
  # Newton-Raphson iteration
  max_iter <- 100
  tol <- 1e-6
  
  for (iter in 1:max_iter) {
    lhs_val <- LHS(Si)
    rhs_val <- RHS(Si)
    diff <- abs(lhs_val - rhs_val)
    
    if (diff / X < tol) {
      break
    }
    
    # Calculate derivative for Newton-Raphson
    d1_val <- d1(Si)
    denom <- (1 - exp(-q * T) * pnorm(d1_val))
    
    if (abs(denom) < 1e-10) {
      break  # Avoid division by near-zero
    }
    
    # Newton-Raphson update: Si_new = Si - f(Si)/f'(Si)
    # Where f(Si) = LHS(Si) - RHS(Si)
    f_Si <- lhs_val - rhs_val
    f_prime <- 1 - (bs_european_call(Si, X, r, sigma, T, q) * q_2 / denom + 
                    (1 - exp(-q * T) * pnorm(d1_val)) / q_2)
    
    if (abs(f_prime) < 1e-10) {
      break  # Avoid division by zero
    }
    
    Si_new <- Si - f_Si / f_prime
    
    # Ensure Si stays reasonable
    if (Si_new <= X || is.infinite(Si_new) || is.nan(Si_new)) {
      break
    }
    
    Si <- Si_new
  }
  
  cat("Find_S_star price: ", Si, "\n")
  return(Si)
}

bs_american_call_user <- function(S, X, r, sigma, T, q) {
  cat("\n=== bs_american_call_user DEBUG ===\n")
  cat("Inputs: S=", S, "X=", X, "r=", r, "sigma=", sigma, "T=", T, "q=", q, "\n")
  
  if (q <= 0) {
    cat("q <= 0, returning European price\n")
    euro_price <- bs_european_call(S, X, r, sigma, T, q)
    cat("European price:", euro_price, "\n")
    return(euro_price)
  }
  
  b <- r - q
  cat("Cost of carry b =", b, "\n")
  
  # Find critical price
  S_star <- find_S_star_call_user(S, X, r, sigma, T, q)
  cat("S_star =", S_star, "\n")
  
  # Calculate q_2
  M <- (2*r)/sigma^2
  N_param <- (2*b)/sigma^2
  q_2 <- (-(N_param - 1) - sqrt((N_param - 1)^2 + 4 * M)) / 2
  cat("M =", M, "N_param =", N_param, "q_2 =", q_2, "\n")
  
  # Calculate d1 at S_star
  d1_val <- (log(S_star/X) + (b + sigma^2 / 2) * T) / (sigma * sqrt(T))
  cat("d1 at S_star =", d1_val, "\n")
  cat("pnorm(d1) =", pnorm(d1_val), "\n")
  cat("1 - exp(-q*T)*pnorm(d1) =", 1 - exp(-q * T) * pnorm(d1_val), "\n")
  
  # Calculate early exercise premium coefficient
  A_2 <- (S_star / q_2) * (1 - exp(-q * T) * pnorm(d1_val))
  cat("A_2 =", A_2, "\n")
  
  euro_price <- bs_european_call(S, X, r, sigma, T, q)
  cat("European call price =", euro_price, "\n")
  
  cat("S >= S_star?", S >= S_star, "\n")
  
  if (S >= S_star) {
    result <- S - X
    cat("Early exercise! Returning S - X =", result, "\n")
    return(result)
  } else {
    S_ratio <- S / S_star
    power_term <- S_ratio ^ q_2
    cat("S_ratio = S/S_star =", S_ratio, "\n")
    cat("S_ratio^q_2 =", S_ratio, "^", q_2, "=", power_term, "\n")
    cat("A_2 * power_term =", A_2, "*", power_term, "=", A_2 * power_term, "\n")
    result <- euro_price + A_2 * power_term
    cat("Final: European (", euro_price, ") + Premium (", A_2 * power_term, ") =", result, "\n")
    cat("====================================\n")
    return(result)
  }
}
```

```{r test-basic}
# ============================================
# BASIC TESTS - European Options
# ============================================

cat("=== Basic European Option Tests ===\n")

test_S <- 100
test_K <- 100
test_r <- 0.05
test_sigma <- 0.2
test_T <- 1
test_q <- 0.02

euro_call <- bs_european_call(test_S, test_K, test_r, test_sigma, test_T, test_q)
euro_put <- bs_european_put(test_S, test_K, test_r, test_sigma, test_T, test_q)

cat("European Call:", euro_call, "\n")
cat("European Put:", euro_put, "\n")

# Put-Call Parity Check
parity_check <- euro_call - euro_put - test_S * exp(-test_q * test_T) + test_K * exp(-test_r * test_T)
cat("\nPut-Call Parity Check (should be ~0):", parity_check, "\n")
```

```{r test-american-call}
# ============================================
# TEST CASE: American Call with Early Exercise
# Condition: q > r (dividend yield > risk-free rate)
# This makes early exercise optimal for deep ITM calls
# ============================================

cat("\n=== Test: American Call with Early Exercise (q > r) ===\n")

# Parameters where American > European for calls
call_test_S <- 100
call_test_K <- 100
call_test_r <- 0.03  # Lower interest rate
call_test_sigma <- 0.2
call_test_T <- 1
call_test_q <- 0.06  # Higher dividend yield (q > r)

euro_call_am <- bs_european_call(call_test_S, call_test_K, call_test_r, call_test_sigma, call_test_T, call_test_q)
cat("European Call (q > r):", euro_call_am, "\n")

cat("\nOriginal BAW implementation:\n")
am_call_orig <- bs_american_call(call_test_S, call_test_K, call_test_r, call_test_sigma, call_test_T, call_test_q)
cat("American Call (Original BAW):", am_call_orig, "\n")

cat("\nUser BAW implementation:\n")
am_call_user <- bs_american_call_user(call_test_S, call_test_K, call_test_r, call_test_sigma, call_test_T, call_test_q)
cat("American Call (User BAW):", am_call_user, "\n")
```

```{r foptions-comparison}
# ============================================
# COMPARISON WITH fOptions CRR BINOMIAL TREE
# ============================================
# Note: Install fOptions first:
# install.packages("remotes")
# remotes::install_github("cran/fOptions")
# Or if already installed: install.packages("fOptions")

cat("\n=== Comparison with fOptions CRR Binomial Tree ===\n")

# Try to load fOptions
tryCatch({
  library(fOptions)
  cat("fOptions loaded successfully!\n")
  
  # Calculate CRR prices with different number of steps
  n_steps <- c(50, 100, 500, 1000)
  
  cat("\n--- American Call Test (q > r) ---\n")
  cat("Parameters: S=", call_test_S, "K=", call_test_K, "r=", call_test_r, 
      "sigma=", call_test_sigma, "T=", call_test_T, "q=", call_test_q, "\n")
  cat("BAW American Call (Original):", am_call_orig, "\n")
  cat("BAW American Call (User):", am_call_user, "\n\n")
  
  for (n in n_steps) {
    crr_am_call <- CRRBinomialTreeOption(TypeFlag = "ca", S = call_test_S, X = call_test_K, Time = call_test_T, 
                                          r = call_test_r, b = call_test_r - call_test_q, sigma = call_test_sigma, n = n)
    cat("CRR Tree (n =", n, ") - American Call:", crr_am_call@price, "\n")
  }
  
  cat("\n--- American Put Test (High r) ---\n")
  cat("Parameters: S=", put_test_S, "K=", put_test_K, "r=", put_test_r, 
      "sigma=", put_test_sigma, "T=", put_test_T, "q=", put_test_q, "\n")
  cat("BAW American Put (Original):", am_put_orig, "\n\n")
  
  for (n in n_steps) {
    crr_am_put <- CRRBinomialTreeOption(TypeFlag = "pa", S = put_test_S, X = put_test_K, Time = put_test_T, 
                                         r = put_test_r, b = put_test_r - put_test_q, sigma = put_test_sigma, n = n)
    cat("CRR Tree (n =", n, ") - American Put:", crr_am_put@price, "\n")
  }
  
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("fOptions not installed or failed to load.\n")
  cat("To install, run:\n")
  cat("  install.packages('remotes')\n")
  cat("  remotes::install_github('cran/fOptions')\n")
  cat("\nError message:", e$message, "\n")
})
```
